t: Mi sheeno baqi batteqiot velo battepilla
s: Mi sheeno baqi batteqiot velo battepilla ubo b' seipim: mi sheeno baqi beseder tepillat musap vegam eno yodea litqoa o sheen lo shopar, ulepanayv shette ayarot, beachat yodein litqoa abal en beqiin bitpillat musap ubeachat beqiin bitpillat musap abal en lahem shopar o sheen yodein litqoa — yelek limqom hatteqiot, apillu im shel teqiot hu besapeq lo veshel musap bevadday, mippene shehatteqiot hen min hattora utepillat musap middibre soperim, vesapeq shel tora qodem levadday dibre soperim:

Veim yakol lelek limqom hammitpalelim veyesh shehut bayyom sheyyishma achar kak hatteqiot bemaqom shettoqein, kegon shehu betok hattechum o sheyyakol lishloach nokri achar hashshopar lehabio lekan apillu michutz lattechum — yeqayyem shette hammitzvot, shekkol hayyom kasher litqiat shopar. Abal lo yelek techilla lammaqom shettoqein veachar kak lammaqom shemmitpalelim, lepi shettepillat musap zemannah qatzar mizzeman teqiat shopar, shehare lekattechilla en leacharah yoter mishsheba shaot kemo shennitbaer besiman rp"v:
